Kill [[Chung, the Attuned]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Chung, the Attuned in [[the Undercity]].
* *BONUS* Kill Chung in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
Head to the [[Nahpui Quarter (outpost)|Nahpui Quarter outpost]] and enter the Undercity from [[Wajjun Bazaar]], as Chung is much closer to that exit than the [[Bukdek Byway]] exit. Be careful when approaching his [[spawn]] location, because he will not appear until you approach his location; and when he does appear, two other groups of [[Am Fah]] will also [[popup]] for an ambush. These groups can all be [[pull]]ed separately; there is no need to try to kill everyone at the same time.

==Dialogues==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Zaishen Bounty]]
:''"Kill Chung, the Attuned in the Undercity."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = This despicable villain still stalks the land, preying on the innocent. Heroes who are up to the challenge should seek this fiend out, taking blood as payment for a life of atrocious deeds.}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*Killing Chung in his alternate location during the quest [[Eliminate the Am Fah]] does not count toward completion. He must be killed at his normal spawn in the Undercity.
*His group is spawned automatically during the quest [[It Ends Here]].
*If a party member has [[Seek out Brother Tosai]] active, the walk to the Undercity will have [[Ally|allied]] Am Fah on it.
*If a party member has the quest [[Chasing Zenmai]] active (particularly, if said party member has reached said quest's second objective in the [[quest log]]), he will not spawn at the marked location.
